transcript.text: Good morning everyone. Let's get this weekly sustainment review started. Before I sign the disposition plan for the materials in the holding area, I need confirmed updates from each of you. We've got used oil drums, vehicle batteries, expired medical cold packs, and empty compressed-air cylinders awaiting disposition. Environmental, maintenance, medical-logistics, and transportation reps — please report your confirmed updates so I can record them in the review record and release material for pickup or return.
